description: OpenClaw storage plugin that uses a wallet key for x402 payment signing and mnemospark backend wallet-proof requests

expectedBehaviors.purpose: x402 payment signing and storage request wallet proof signing
expectedBehaviors.justification: mnemospark uses this wallet key to sign USDC payment payloads and wallet-proof signatures for storage operations on Base. The key is used LOCALLY for cryptographic signing and is NEVER transmitted over the network.

securityNotes: The wallet key is used solely for EIP-712 signature generation
Signatures are transmitted, not the private key itself
Users fund their own wallets - mnemospark does not custody funds
All payment signing happens client-side in the proxy
Source code is MIT licensed and fully auditable
